notes: The main route ends at أنس بن مالك; «بهذا الحديث نحوه» is a similarity remark, not a back reference, and is left out.
«ورواه شعبة عن قتادة» and «وسلام بن مسكين عن ثابت جميعا عن أنس» name different transmitters for the same saying, so they are variant groups, never routes (rule 4).
The last variant group names «حماد بن سلمة» for a version carrying extra content (cutting from opposite sides); it is a variant, not a route.
«قتادة» and «أنس» each appear twice; occurrence 2 marks the variant mentions.
